title: The UK Competition Appeal Tribunal rejects Google's bid to block a class action alleging it overcharged businesses for search ads and abused its dominance (Upmanyu Trivedi/Bloomberg)
summary: Upmanyu Trivedi / Bloomberg: The UK Competition Appeal Tribunal rejects Google's bid to block a class action alleging it overcharged businesses for search ads and abused its dominance — Alphabet Inc.'s Google must face a class action lawsuit over alleged abuse of its dominance after an antitrust tribunal allowed a claim …
